html:
SMTO-CMP-0021 — The AI tried to finish without writing the final reply

GUID: 32b2b35a-2b5c-4d7c-a179-62c1cd1fd118
Slug: completion-missing-message
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • This task needs a written reply at the end, but the AI model tried to finish without one. SMTO asked it to write the reply. Work already done and its results are kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. SMTO only needs the AI to write the reply from results it already has.
  2. Or type a request such as "Summarize what you did" in the "Continue this conversation" box under the task and select Continue. This asks for the reply directly, and SMTO can answer from the saved results.
  3. If this keeps happening, ask the person who manages SMTO to try a different Main model in Settings › Setup › Model routing. Writing the reply is the AI model's job, and some models skip it more often.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed and a final reply appears under it.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the task just to get a reply; that would repeat all of its actions.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The effective output contract requires a final message, but the submitted finish_task or summarized-completion message was empty or whitespace (reason missing_message).

What this means

  • The effective output contract requires a message but the submitted final message is empty/whitespace, including ordinary summarized completion. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • The effective output contract requires a message but the submitted final message is empty/whitespace, including ordinary summarized completion.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the accepted output requirement and retained answer before requesting another response.

How to fix it

  • Check terminal_output_contract and the submitted message (validate_output and _assess_output in src/agent_runtime/native/output_contract.py; dispatch_control in native/controls.py). Resume so the model supplies a non-empty final message grounded in the existing receipts; the completion.output_contract Agent Check governs enforcement and no operation needs to run again.
  • Supply a supported final message grounded in the observed results.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported nonempty final message grounded in the existing results is supplied.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
